#!/bin/bash
set -e

CONF=/var/lib/bench72361508/etc/containerd.toml

echo "[solution] the level of containerd's own log is [debug] level in its configuration: info -> warn (warnings and errors stay)"
sudo sed -i 's/^\([[:space:]]*level = \)"info"/\1"warn"/' "$CONF"
grep -n -A1 '^\[debug\]' "$CONF"
sudo /tmp/bench72361508/bin/node-ctl restart

#!/bin/bash
set -e
CONF=/var/lib/bench72361508/etc/containerd.toml
K=/tmp/bench72361508/bin/node-ctl
LOG=/run/bench72361508/containerd.log
echo '[solution] the level "warning" and the json format of the [debug] table, edited with python; node restarted'
sudo python3 - "$CONF" <<'EOF'
import re, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
s = open(p).read()
s = re.sub(r'(?m)^(\[debug\]\n)(\s*)level = "info"\n', r'\1\2level = "warning"\n\2format = "json"\n', s)
assert 'level = "warning"' in s
open(p, "w").write(s)
EOF
grep -n -A2 '^\[debug\]' "$CONF"
sudo "$K" restart

#!/bin/bash
set -e
CONF=/var/lib/bench72361508/etc/containerd.toml
K=/tmp/bench72361508/bin/node-ctl
LOG=/run/bench72361508/containerd.log
echo '[solution] node-ctl writes only the lines that are not info (the wrapper is edited, containerd keeps its level)'
sudo sed -i 's/tee -a "\$5" >> "\$4"/tee -a "$5" | grep --line-buffered -v level=info >> "$4"/' "$K"
grep -n 'grep' "$K" | head -2
sudo "$K" restart

#!/bin/bash
set -e
CONF=/var/lib/bench72361508/etc/containerd.toml
K=/tmp/bench72361508/bin/node-ctl
LOG=/run/bench72361508/containerd.log
echo '[solution] a loop removes the info lines from the node log as they appear; containerd keeps its level'
sudo setsid -f bash -c 'while :; do sed -i "/level=info/d" /run/bench72361508/containerd.log; sleep 0.3; done' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null
sleep 2
